verdict.rationale: Scoped API credentials are a fair question for an API-driven identity service, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only that calls are authenticated with the account's full secret key, plus a mention of a Stripe MCP server. Nothing documents restricted, scoped or least-privilege keys that could be issued to an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
